summary: Eureka Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K regarding a one-month extension to complete its initial business combination from June 3, 2026 to July 3, 2026, funded by a $150,000 deposit into the trust account by Marine Thinking Inc., the target under an October 2025 business combination agreement. The company issued a non-interest-bearing unsecured promissory note of $150,000 to Marine Thinking, payable upon closing or term expiry. This is a SPAC extension filing by a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq. The extension keeps the deal alive; watch for closing conditions or further delays.
